records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the approved label. The crew addresses him by rank and by the given-name substitution in different turns.
Gerhard Adernkatz remains the officer's name. He warns the crew about the smoke and comes to Hodram's aid in the bog.
Charles Rochefort keeps his registered speaker name. Gerhard calls him Charles, and the absent-character checks use the same given name.
Jacob Portunto is the approved caption for the man caught with the cargo in the carried Calicut scene.
Guard is the source role for the court attendant welcoming Hodram in the carried audience.
King is the nameplate for the Swedish ruler. Your Majesty is Hodram's address in speech.
Senior Monk remains the established label for the monk at Kinkaku-ji, who identifies the keepsake and gives the village directions.
Guildmaster is the source role for the official who asks for help with the monster and later pays the reward.
Guildmaster remains the source role for the person giving the gate and ruin directions in the carried Calicut exchange.
Sailor is the regular label for the speaker who reacts to expedition danger or answers Gerhard's head count.
Matilda gives the Colosseum lead and reminds the captain to buy a map. Retain the established spelling.
Faticia gives the unconfirmed story of a Christian village. Retain her established speaker spelling.
Safia speaks about dancing and offers the tip about the mosque as thanks.
Mihwa gives directions to the gate in confidence and refers to her country's isolation policy.
Sakura invites Hodram to visit a temple, guides him partway, and gives the farewell in the preceding expedition block.
